annotation.title_en: Information Security Policy - Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship (Jordan)
annotation.summary_en: Jordan's Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship information security policy. It commits to confidentiality, integrity and availability of information assets, adopts ISO 27001, risk assessment and staff awareness training, and applies to employees and contractors. The collected page does not match the title about the draft AI ethics charter, and contains no AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adopts ISO 27001 information security management system
Steering committee chaired by the Ministry's Secretary General
Applies to permanent and temporary staff, contractors and partners
Security controls based on risk assessment and cost-benefit comparison
Promotes security culture through training and awareness
